retro.version_update: Retro card updated to v{v} — please reload
retro.version_reload_stuck: Reload didn't pick up the new version. Close this browser tab and reopen the dashboard, or clear your browser's site data for Home Assistant.
retro.entity_missing: Sensor {entity} no longer exists. Pick a different sensor in the entity selector above.

editor.walk_time_hint: Hide departures that would already be gone by the time you reach the platform. Leave blank for no filter.
editor.walk_time_branching_hint: Applies to all termini in this direction
editor.walk_time_no_data: No departures in this direction. Switch direction or wait until the sensor reports lines.
editor.walk_time_aria: Walk time in minutes for line {line} towards {towards}
editor.platform_side_helper: Default follows Wiener Linien signage (platform 2 on the left, otherwise right). Override manually if needed.
editor.message_ticker_helper: Runs a custom message across the display every 5 minutes.
editor.message_text_helper: The text that scrolls across the display.
editor.section_header_helper: Black strip above the station name, like on U-Bahn signs. Optional.
editor.show_header_helper: Turn on to show the black strip above the station name. Per-side settings stay saved when off.
editor.header_left_helper: Exit icon sits on the left edge.
editor.header_right_helper: Exit icon sits on the right edge.
editor.text_helper: E.g. name of the next station.
editor.show_clock_helper: Current time (HH:MM) as a white chip at the innermost edge of this side.
editor.show_date_helper: Current date as a white chip next to the clock.
editor.date_format_helper: Example: d.m.Y → 25.05.2026. Tokens: d j (day), m n (month), Y y (year), D l (weekday), M F (month name). Anything else passes through unchanged.
editor.extra_icons_helper: Pick up to 3 MDI icons per side. Type to search the catalog, or paste an mdi: key.
editor.chips_helper: Short labels after the icons (e.g. platform or line numbers). Up to 6, 16 characters each.
editor.section_tweaks_helper: Visual flourishes. No data behaviour, just looks.
editor.show_unit_helper: Trail each countdown number with a small amber "min" caption.
editor.line_pill_helper: Render the line code as a filled pill in the official line colour with white LED text.
editor.line_stripe_helper: A 4 px coloured bar at the left edge of each row, matched to the line.
editor.housing_helper: Dark bezel around the LED panel with a subtle glass reflection on top.

flap.version_update: Flap card updated to v{v} — please reload
flap.version_reload_stuck: Reload didn't pick up the new version. Close this browser tab and reopen the dashboard, or clear your browser's site data for Home Assistant.
flap.entity_missing: Sensor {entity} no longer exists. Pick a different sensor in the entity selector above.

editor.stop_section_hint: Filter this stop’s departures. Pick “Both” to merge both directions; leave lines empty to include all lines at the stop.
editor.walk_time_hint: Hide departures that would already be gone by the time you reach the platform. Leave blank for no filter.
editor.walk_time_branching_hint: Applies to all termini in this direction
editor.walk_time_no_data: No departures matched. Pick a direction or wait until the sensor reports lines.
editor.walk_time_aria: Walk time in minutes for line {line} towards {towards}
editor.max_rows_helper: How many departures to show on the board (1–8). Merged across all stops, sorted by countdown.
editor.section_station_helper: The coloured band with the station name + clock at the top of the board.
editor.show_station_name_helper: Coloured band with the station name and current time at the top of the card.
editor.station_bg_helper: Default is the colour of the first tracked line (e.g. red for U1, orange for U3). On multi-line boards you can pick a specific line, or override with solid white or black.
editor.section_tweaks_helper: Visual flourishes. No data behaviour, just looks.
editor.line_pill_helper: Drops the line column from the board entirely. Useful when the card is scoped to a single line (the line is implicit).
editor.housing_helper: Wraps the board in the cabinet with a soft inset bevel and drop shadow. Cabinet colour follows your HA theme (cream on light, dark on dark). When off, the board sits flush against the dashboard.
editor.show_accessibility_helper: Add a wheelchair pictogram tile next to step-free departures.
editor.show_min_unit_helper: Small label next to the countdown number, like real station boards.
editor.hide_attribution_helper: When on, the CC-BY credit at the bottom of the card is hidden. The Wiener Linien Open Government Data licence requires visible attribution unless you keep the credit elsewhere on the dashboard.
editor.show_platform_helper: Adds a per-row platform tile between the destination and the countdown. Only shown when at least one visible row has a platform value.
editor.section_header_helper: Dark band above the orange station band with exit icons, amenity tiles, chips, clock + date. Optional.
editor.show_header_helper: Master toggle. Per-side settings stay saved when off.
editor.header_left_helper: Exit icon sits on the left edge.
editor.header_right_helper: Exit icon sits on the right edge.
editor.text_helper: E.g. name of the next station.
editor.show_clock_helper: Current time (HH:MM) as a cream chip at the innermost edge of this side.
editor.show_date_helper: Current date as a cream chip next to the clock.
editor.date_format_helper: Example: d.m.Y → 25.05.2026. Tokens: d j (day), m n (month), Y y (year), D l (weekday), M F (month name). Anything else passes through unchanged.
editor.extra_icons_helper: Pick up to 3 MDI icons per side. Type to search the catalog, or paste an mdi: key.
editor.chips_helper: Short labels after the icons (e.g. platform or line numbers). Up to 6, 16 characters each.
